evidence.quote: Standard period of study 8 semesters (incl. Industrial Internship and Bachelor Thesis), 240 ECTS
The fees for international students from non-EU countries amount to €1,500 per semester.
If you are not from an EU country, the tuition fee is € 1,500 per semester.
Registration deadline for the winter term: 30 September 2026

notes: The programme is taught in English. German language courses are integrated, and elective courses in German can be chosen in higher semesters, but the degree is not taught in German. The tuition fee for non-EU students is €1,500 per semester (as stated on the programme page and on the general non-EU tuition fees page where Engineering Physics is listed). The application deadline of 30 September 2026 is for the winter semester 2026; it is not stated whether this applies to subsequent years. The application channel is uni-assist VPD (preliminary review documentation) for international applicants; the VPD is required, but the actual application may still be submitted via the university's online portal (as indicated by 'Application online' and 'Submit application via Please check this website'), so applicants should verify the exact route.

note.fr: Vérifier les exigences d'entrée supplémentaires : qualification d'entrée à l'université, certificat APS, VPD de uni-assist ou évaluation du ZAB, CV.
note.en: Check additional admission requirements: university entrance qualification, APS certificate, VPD from uni-assist or ZAB evaluation, CV.

evidence.quote: Admission requirements University entrance qualification, entrance qualification for universities of applied sciences, vocational qualification or foreign educational certificate
International applicants require a certificate assessment (APS certificate, VPD from uniassist or evaluation of the ZAB).
